title: Interoperability (JS to Python)
description: PyScript's interoperability allows seamless communication between Python and JavaScript, enabling you to leverage both languages' strengths in a single application. Call Python functions from JavaScript, access browser APIs from Python, and share data bidirectionally.
tryIt: Try it: Enter your name and age below. The form data will be sent to a Python function that processes it and generates a personalized greeting.

architecture.title: 🏗️ Architecture Highlights
architecture.description: This example demonstrates proper separation of concerns:
architecture.python: Python - Pure business logic, sends only data via window callbacks (no innerHTML!)
architecture.controller: InteropController - Manages Python lifecycle and communication layer
architecture.ui: Svelte UIHandler - Pure UI rendering with reactive state based on data received

howWorks.title: How It Works:
howWorks.pattern: Controller Pattern: InteropController manages Python setup and callbacks
howWorks.dataOnly: Data-Only Communication: Python sends plain objects, Svelte renders the UI
howWorks.reactive: Reactive UI: Svelte automatically updates when data changes
howWorks.eventDriven: Event-Driven: User interactions trigger Python functions

useCases.title: Use Cases:
useCases.formData: Process form data with Python's powerful libraries
useCases.dynamicUI: Update UI dynamically based on Python computations
useCases.combine: Combine JavaScript frameworks (like Svelte) with Python logic
useCases.dataSci: Access Python's data science ecosystem from web interfaces
